# 150 Winter Wildlife Video Prompts for Seedance 2.0 (USA & Canada)

15-second, 9:16, smartphone-style prompts set in real snowy, icy and freezing locations across the United States and Canada. Each one has a 0–2 second hook, a second-by-second timeline, natural sound only, and the 12-section structure below. They are written for Seedance 2.0 with Seedance 2.5-level realism as the target.

**Every prompt contains these sections, in this order:** FORMAT · LOOK · CAMERA · LOCATION · CHARACTERS · HOOK (00:00–00:02) · TIMELINE (00:00–00:15, second by second) · SOUND DESIGN · AUDIO REALISM · 4K/8K VISUAL QUALITY ENHANCEMENT · REALISM AND CONTINUITY · AVOID

**Ground rules for all 150:** wildlife and nature only, with no rescue scenarios and no people handling animals. Native North American species, natural sound only (no music, voiceover or dialogue), one continuous handheld phone take, and no repeats of each other or of the four reference clips.

Copy a prompt with the copy button on its code block.
